headline.purpose: Clinic identity and top-level page statements.

title.purpose: Section headings, service names, records, and orders.

body.purpose: Descriptions, summaries, helper copy, and health notes.

label.purpose: Chips, route labels, tabs, dates, and metadata.

shadows.name: card-ambient

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one clear appointment action on a page.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 88rpx; padding: 0 28rpx; border: 0; border-radius: 18rpx; color: #FFFFFF; background: #E76F3C; font: 800 28rpx/1.25 PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 10rpx 22rpx rgba(231, 111, 60, 0.20); transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #C95B2F; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3rpx solid #FFD8C7; outline-offset: 4rpx; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1rpx); } .ds-btn-primary[disabled] { opacity: 0.55; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-emphasis action that stays available without competing with booking.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 84rpx; padding: 0 24rpx; border: 1rpx solid #DEE1E4; border-radius: 18rpx; color: #2D3035; background: #FFFFFF; font: 800 28rpx/1.25 PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #E76F3C; background: #FFF0E7; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3rpx solid #FFD8C7; outline-offset: 4rpx; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: #F4F5F6; }

components.name: Service Chip
components.description: A swipeable service choice with price and duration metadata.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; width: 300rpx; min-height: 132rpx; padding: 22rpx 24rpx; border: 2rpx solid #DEE1E4; border-radius: 30rpx; color: #2D3035; background: #FFFFFF; font-family: PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-chip-title { overflow: hidden; width: 100%; font-size: 28rpx; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.3; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-meta { margin-top: 10rpx; color: #73777D; font-size: 22rpx; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip.is-active { border-color: #E76F3C; background: #FFF0E7; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3rpx solid #FFD8C7; outline-offset: 4rpx; } .ds-chip:active { transform: translateY(1rpx); }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: A white, bordered container for a focused service or health record.
components.html:
身体记录

气虚夹湿 · 2026年8月4日
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24rpx 28rpx; border: 1rpx solid #DEE1E4; border-radius: 24rpx; color: #2D3035; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 8rpx 24rpx rgba(45, 48, 53, 0.06); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; color: #17191C; font: 800 32rpx/1.28 PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 12rpx 0 0; color: #73777D; font: 400 26rpx/1.62 PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; } .ds-card:focus-within { border-color: #E76F3C; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: A quiet, readable field for health records and short booking details.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8rpx; color: #73777D; font: 700 22rpx/1.35 PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 84rpx; padding: 0 24rpx; border: 1rpx solid #DEE1E4; border-radius: 24rpx; box-sizing: border-box; color: #2D3035; background: #FFFFFF; font: 400 26rpx/1.62 PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9AA0A6; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #E76F3C; outline: 3rpx solid #FFD8C7; outline-offset: 2rpx; } .ds-input:disabled { color: #9AA0A6; background: #F4F5F6; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Tab Navigation
components.description: The native four-destination WeChat navigation with a quiet active signal.
components.html: 首页预约档案我的
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); min-height: 96rpx; border-top: 1rpx solid #DEE1E4; background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 96rpx; color: #73777D; font: 700 22rpx/1.35 PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab.is-active { color: #E76F3C; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3rpx solid #FFD8C7; outline-offset: -4rpx; } .ds-tab:active { background: #FFF0E7; }

components.name: Booking Route
components.description: A three-step route that makes the next appointment decision obvious.
components.html:
01选择服务
02选择技师
03选择时段
components.css: .ds-route { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 20rpx 18rpx; border: 1rpx solid #DEE1E4; border-radius: 20rpx; background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-route-step { display: flex; flex: 0 0 112rpx; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8rpx; color: #73777D; font: 400 22rpx/1.2 PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; text-align: center; } .ds-route-step span { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44rpx; height: 44rpx; border: 1rpx solid #DEE1E4; border-radius: 50%; color: #73777D; background: #FFFFFF; font: 800 20rpx/1 PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; } .ds-route-step.is-active { color: #E76F3C; font-weight: 800; } .ds-route-step.is-active span { border-color: #E76F3C; color: #FFFFFF; background: #E76F3C; } .ds-route i { height: 1rpx; flex: 1; margin: 0 6rpx 28rpx; background: #DEE1E4; }

narrative.northStar: The Quiet Service Route（静谧预约路径）
narrative.overview:
这是一套服务优先的微信小程序视觉系统：让顾客在短暂、单手的访问里，先知道下一步，再决定看哪些信息。冷灰画布承托白色内容面，炭黑文字负责可信与可读，橘红只在预约动作、选择状态和路径进度出现，形成明确而克制的方向感。

页面保持平面、干净、轻量的层次。卡片用细边框和很弱的环境阴影分组，不把疗愈体验包装成泛化的科技产品；内容、价格、技师和时段都以真实业务数据为中心。本文档约束 customer-facing 页面（首页、预约、档案、个人中心及其详情路径）；微信 Tab 导航、安全区和原生返回手势保持不变，移动管理端和技师端不在本表面的视觉范围内。
keyCharacteristics: Cool gray canvas + white service surfaces
Mandarin orange as a scarce action and selection signal
Charcoal, high-contrast type with quiet metadata hierarchy
Flat depth: hairline borders first, restrained shadows second
Single-hand rhythm with short, scannable content blocks

rules.name: The Orange Is a Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve Mandarin Orange for the next action, a selected state, route progress, or an explicit price/link. Never wash an entire page in orange.

rules.name: The Weight Before Color Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with size and weight first; use orange to clarify action or state, not to make ordinary copy louder.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Start with a white surface and a hairline border; add a soft shadow only when it explains a state or a layer boundary.

dos: Do use Mandarin Orange (#E76F3C) for the primary appointment action, active route step, selected state, price, or explicit link.
Do keep the Cool Gray Canvas (#F4F5F6), White Service Surface, Hairline Border (#DEE1E4), and Charcoal text relationship consistent across customer pages.
Do preserve generous touch areas (at least the existing 84–88rpx button heights), safe-area insets, and native WeChat Tab navigation.
Do pair status colors with words, icons, or labels so availability, errors, and cancellation are never color-only.
Do let real store, service, practitioner, slot, order, and health-record data carry the story; keep promotional content subordinate to the next useful action.
donts: Don't add gradients, glass effects, backdrop filters, or translucent “AI product” surfaces to customer-facing pages.
Don't decorate with emoji, floating sparkle motifs, or generic technology illustrations; use the existing icon assets and plain text labels.
Don't turn Mandarin Orange into a full-page wash or use it for ordinary body copy that is not interactive.
Don't introduce oversized rounded card stacks (for example, new core cards at 36rpx+) when a 24rpx surface is sufficient.
Don't alter the WeChat Tab bar, safe-area behavior, existing API/data flows, or product facts while applying this visual system.
